title: Blueberry Almond Milk Smoothie (Dairy-Free)
excerpt: Enjoy a creamy, light and 100% dairy-free smoothie. The smoothness of almond milk brings out the natural sweetness of our fresh blueberries.
imageAlt: Tall glass with a blueberry almond milk smoothie, decorated with fresh blueberries on top.

ingredients.text: 1 tablespoon bee honey or agave syrup (optional)

steps: In the blender jar, pour the almond milk and add the vanilla extract along with the sweetener if you decide to use it.
Add the Fresh Pick blueberries, grown in the high mountains of Guasca, and the ice cubes.
Blend on high speed for 1 to 2 minutes until you get a creamy, even consistency.
Taste the smoothie and adjust the sweetness with an extra touch of honey if you prefer.
Serve immediately in two tall glasses and enjoy it freshly made.
tips: For an ultra-creamy shake without diluting the flavor with ice, freeze the Fresh Pick blueberries for a couple of hours before blending them.
To keep the quality of your blueberries at home, store them in the refrigerator in a container with paper towel at the bottom and wash them only right before eating.
